what: The Isaiah passages Townsend (2025) ties to Adam Clarke's commentary, rebuilt from Jackson's reply because Townsend's article was not in hand. Townsend's own appendix (pp. 77-83 of his article) may list more; this is the set Jackson treats as complete.
source: Jackson, 'Adam Clarke and Isaiah in the Book of Mormon', Interpreter 66 (2025) 131-150, which says it examines every passage Townsend identifies, in the order of his article

items.claimed_link: 'then' added and verb before subject, as in Clarke's rendering
items.jackson_objection: the book adds 'then' to four other Isaiah verses where Clarke does not; verb-first after 'then' is the usual order

items.claimed_link: words of the verse linked to Clarke's cross-references (Malachi 4, Psalm 72:4, Job 4:9)
items.jackson_objection: the verse is the narrator's comment, not Isaiah; the links are loose

items.claimed_link: Clarke's 'dried up' said to lie behind the changed clause about the fish
items.jackson_objection: in Clarke the fish are dried up; in the book the waters are, and the fish still stink

items.claimed_link: added closing clause linked to the clause Clarke restores from verses 19 and 21
items.jackson_objection: no word in common; Townsend says Smith misunderstood Clarke

items.claimed_link: added 'upon all the nations ... every people' linked to Clarke's comment on kings and kingdoms

items.jackson_objection: Clarke replaces 'not' with 'their'; the book only drops it

items.claimed_link: 'in the day' becomes 'in that day', as Clarke recommends
items.jackson_objection: 'in that day' is frequent in Isaiah; the book also adds a clause Clarke does not
'the nations' is far commoner in the King James text; possible slip of ear or pen

items.claimed_link: first-person 'I' shared with the Syriac and Vulgate reading Clarke quotes
words added before the verse linked to Clarke's 'distant lands'
items.jackson_objection: the verse itself is unchanged; Townsend compares the added preface

items.claimed_link: 'read it' and 'sealed up' as in Clarke's rendering
items.jackson_objection: 'read it' comes after a long insertion; 'sealed up' is not at this verse and was common idiom
